Where an onsite visit is required, you will ensure the attending engineer has the information needed to resolve the issue efficiently. You will also attend some proactive maintenance visits and reactive or emergency callouts when required. Provide first-line technical diagnosis and remote support across smart home, AV, networking, lighting control and associated systems.  Wherever possible, diagnose and resolve issues remotely, using the remote access and monitoring tools available.  Ensure remote monitoring and remote access tools are correctly configured and maintained for all Aftercare and warranty clients, ensuring systems are visible, monitoring is active and the information held is accurate and up to date.  Ensure every open technical ticket has a clear next action, owner and timescale, proactively following up outstanding actions rather than allowing tickets to stall.  Maintain excellent communication with clients throughout an issue, providing clear updates, managing expectations and explaining technical matters in an understandable way.  Escalate complex, recurring or unresolved technical issues to the appropriate senior technical resource, providing a clear summary of the investigation and troubleshooting already undertaken. Experience using a helpdesk/ticketing platform; Zendesk experience would be beneficial.  The ability to manage and prioritise multiple live issues while ensuring agreed response times and SLAs are maintained.  A methodical starter/finisher mentality, taking ownership of issues and seeing them through to conclusion.
